name: Beryl Drugs Limited
about: Beryl Drugs Limited engages in the manufacture and marketing of pharmaceutical products in India. It offers various branded and generic pharmaceutical formulations, bulk drugs, I.V. fluids, small volume injectables in liquid and dry powder forms, and eye and ear drops, as well as veterinary products. The company also provides research and development, and contract manufacturing services. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Indore, India.
